payload.cancel_metadata: Exit Cancel is the mutable MSForms.ReturnBoolean helper (the by_ref Cancel arg). The dispatching runtime reads back the post-handler Cancel via control.PerformExit (oxforms-esq.2) and folds it back as FocusValidationCompleted (oxforms-esq.4): focus is held pending until then, so a veto (Cancel=True) retains focus on this control.

scenario.description: Deterministic headless replay of the W005 Label/TextBox/CommandButton probe path through oxforms-pal UiEvent rows, oxforms-core reduce(), probe display-list emission, and PAL headless render hashing.

warnings: This golden is OxForms headless regression evidence, not MSForms oracle evidence.
VBA dispatch rows are metadata reconstructed from reducer FireVbaEvent effects; no OxVba or VBA handler is executed by this headless runner.
The render hash is the PAL smoke FillRect projection hash, not text or pixel parity evidence.
